title: Exception-led metadata with stable details
mechanism: Suppress only safely redundant metadata; always show overdue/divergent dates and keep labeled Details stable at each scope. Unknown or divergent context remains visible; Details is always explicit. Retain dates when context cannot be proven identical. Use selected reference context, never wall-clock assumptions. Omit only context proven redundant; retain uncertain and overdue dates. Retain uncertain context and make Details a stable local route. Compare exact actual context; when uncertain retain the date and keep every field in Details.
visible: Completion, title, exceptional dates, exact selected period and active scope/filter context.
disclosed: All nonexception metadata remains in Detalles; page/section options and summary preserve every statistic and edit action.
access: 44px nonoverlapping targets, scoped labels, keyboard disclosure, visible focus/return, 320px wrapping and reduced motion.
benefit: Reduces repeated signals while keeping unusual obligations visible.
risk: A mistaken context comparison could suppress a needed date.
verification: Test mixed dates, overdue tasks, inherited frequencies and history; verify details always reveals complete values.
